title: EGPA — Escritório Galego-Português Antigo
institution: Universidade de Santiago de Compostela (HERES project; direction Ricardo Pichel, now Universidad de Alcalá) with GITHE, UNED
notes: Open collaborative platform of transcribed Galician-Portuguese archival documents (EGPAdoc) and literary texts (EGPAlit) from the Middle Ages to the 19th century, with paleographic and critical presentation; freely readable without login; per-document TEI at corpora.uah.es/egpa/xmlfiles/<id>.xml (checked EGPAdoc-0061). Most material is 12th-15th century; only a handful of documents dated 1478-1566 fall within 1450-1700. The counts cover the 5 documents dated within 1450-1700, and 20 documents without a date in the header are not counted. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
